guarantee.title: Guarantee
guarantee.text: If we missed a required document or linked to a site that isn’t official, we refund you the same day.
guarantee.process: Just reply to our email — that’s the whole process.

gov.a: No. Entry Check is an independent reference service. We gather the requirements for your route and send you to the official sites, where you file yourself.

apply.q: Do you file applications for me?
apply.a: No. You file on the official website and pay the fee directly to the government — with no markup from us.

data.q: Where does the data come from, and how fresh is it?
data.a: Only from official sources: immigration authorities, foreign ministries and embassies. A person verifies every rule, and the verification date is on every card. We re-check rules for our main countries at least every 30 days.

pack.a: A printable PDF checklist, email reminders the moment each filing window opens, a re-check of your route 72 hours before departure, and an email if the rules change after you buy.

changes.q: What if the rules change after I buy?
changes.a: We monitor official sources. If a rule for your route changes, we email you what changed and what to do now.

refund.q: How do I get a refund?
refund.a: Reply to any of our emails. If we missed a required document or a link turned out not to be official, we refund you the same day. Details in our <link>refund policy</link>.
